prompt: Show a catalog of products in a grid with column headers, rows that have an action button per row, and controls at the bottom to jump between pages of results. Add a small badge on some rows to mark a product as popular.

samples.response:
<style>

</style>
<bl-table>
  <bl-table-header sticky>
    <bl-table-cell>Product</bl-table-cell>
    <bl-table-cell>Price</bl-table-cell>
    <bl-table-cell>Status</bl-table-cell>
    <bl-table-cell>Action</bl-table-cell>
  </bl-table-header>
  <bl-table-body>

      <bl-table-cell>Cappuccino Machine</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell>$89.00</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-badge size="small">In stock</bl-badge></bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-button size="small" label="View" variant="secondary"></bl-button></bl-table-cell>
    </bl-table-row>
    <bl-table-row>
      <bl-table-cell>Espresso Beans (1kg)</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell>$24.50</bl-table-cell>

    </bl-table-row>
    <bl-table-row>
      <bl-table-cell>Pour-Over Kettle</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell>$59.00</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-badge size="small">Popular</bl-badge></bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-button size="small" label="View" variant="secondary"></bl-button></bl-table-cell>
    </bl-table-row>
    <bl-table-row>

      <bl-table-cell>$34.00</bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-badge size="small">Out of stock</bl-badge></bl-table-cell>
      <bl-table-cell><bl-button size="small" label="View" variant="secondary"></bl-button></bl-table-cell>
    </bl-table-row>
  </bl-table-body>

<bl-pagination id="catalog-pagination" current-page="1" total-items="124" items-per-page="10"></bl-pagination>

<script>
  const pagination = document.getElementById('catalog-pagination');
  pagination.addEventListener('bl-change', (event) => {
    const { selectedPage } = event.detail;
    console.log(`Loading page ${selectedPage}...`);
  });
</script>
